fusions.name: Crag Butt
fusions.desc: A headbutt that deals 15 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Scree Spray
fusions.desc: Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back. Sprays a cone of spores 5 tiles long that deals 7 damage to everything caught in it, each hit with a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Clinging Crust
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 15% for 10 seconds and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Holding Ground
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, healing you receive is 30% stronger for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
